description: Committed smoke set for scripts/research_bench.py: eight invented documents (written by make_smoke_pdfs.py; every name, title, DOI and arXiv id is made up) that reproduce failure shapes seen on real papers. They exist so the benchmark runs with no download and no network; their numbers say nothing about real accuracy. Bump `version` when a document or a label changes.

labels.title: Lighthouse Indexing for Coastal Sensor Archives

entries.note: the easy case: one column, arXiv stamp and DOI printed

labels.title: Sparse Lexicons Outperform Dense Maps on Short Harbour Logbook Queries

entries.note: venue header, two-line title, author line with affiliation marks and no commas

labels.title: Tidal Memory in Long Sensor Records

entries.note: words separated by kerning rather than space characters, so the text layer runs them together

labels.title: Storm Surge Memory in Enclosed Harbours

entries.note: a quotation and the name of the person quoted sit above the title
the title is an image; the text layer starts with the authors and the abstract

labels.title: Notes on Breakwater Settlement at the Old Quay

entries.note: an image-only page: nothing can be read without OCR

labels.title: A Field Guide to Salt Marsh Grasses

entries.note: cover with "by" line, copyright page with an ISBN, preface
a corporate author and no identifiers at all
